# Third-party software

SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, copyright SheetJS LLC, is distributed unchanged under Apache License 2.0. See [the complete license](SheetJS-LICENSE.txt) and the notices included inside the original package.

Official distribution: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz

SHA-256: `8dc73fc3b00203e72d176e85b50938627c7b086e607c682e8d3c22c02bb99fe8`.

The package is used only for server-side spreadsheet parsing and synthetic acceptance fixtures. Workbook cells are rendered as text. Formula calculation, VBA extraction, HTML output and automatic external-content resolution are not supported.
